name: VESPA CRABRO
head_symptoms: Painful and swollen. Erysipelatous inflammation of lids. Chemosis of conjunctiva. Swelling of mouth and throat, with violent burning pains.
skin_symptoms: Erythema; intense itching; burning. Boils; stinging and soreness, relieved by bathing with vinegar. Wheals, macules and swellings with burning, stinging and soreness. Erythema multiforme, relieved by bathing with vinegar.

source.title: VESPA CRABRO - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
